svg.title: Scheduler lifecycle — vertical main flow
svg.desc: Follow A through F down the page. Waiting, preemption and restoration belong to admission. Selection combines prefill granularity and batching policy. Different requests and loop depths can share compatible recurrent execution. Progress returns to ready queues. PD and safe retirement attach to the relevant steps.
svg.text: Independent requests. Loop-level decisions. Shared execution.
Victim returns to WAITING; restores its saved WorkKey.
Priority / fairness · free KV · reserved growth · protected users
Work queues — one pending WorkKey per request
PRELUDE + all recurrent loops of one prompt chunk
Select compatible work → build one batch
MIXED EXAMPLE · SAME RECURRENT OPERATION, INDEPENDENT DEPTHS
Token ranges + depths · token / KV budget · connector readiness
Ordinary runner / local draft–verify → shared runtime
Prepare CPU → prepare GPU → selected operation(s), eager or graph
Events protect input / result / KV lifetimes
Collect required host results; async execution overlaps independent work.
Update Request → enqueue the next WorkKey, or finish.
KV growth blocked → safe victim / otherwise defer
Connector readiness / backpressure → defer unsafe selection
Event-covered logical progress; no host readback needed
EOS / output limit; external cancellation or error can also enter here.
Blue: main flow / requeue Purple: capacity pressure Amber: PD / readiness Dashed: logical advance
Control flow does not imply global synchronization. No runnable work yields to pending device or transport progress.
